name: Oreo Cookies
description: Classic chocolate sandwich cookies with a sweet cream filling. A recognizable treat that pairs with milk, coffee, or as a quick dessert. Nutrition data below is per 100 grams, which is roughly 10 cookies.

faqs.q: How many calories are in a single Oreo cookie?
faqs.a: A single classic Oreo cookie weighs about 11 grams and contains roughly 53 calories. The 100 gram serving size listed above is equivalent to about 9 to 10 cookies.

faqs.q: Are Oreo cookies high in sugar?
faqs.a: Yes. A 100 gram serving contains 32 grams of sugar, which is over 60 percent of the recommended daily limit. The sugar comes from both the cookie wafers and the cream filling.
